title: Valley of Spears
wikitext:
[[Image:Valley_spears.jpg|thumb|Maraudine centaur in the Valley of Spears]]
The '''Valley of Spears''' {{coords|33|57|Desolace}} is home of the [[Maraudine]] [[Centaur]] clan (lvl 37-42). It is found in western [[Desolace]], and is the location of the underground [[dungeon]] of [[Maraudon]].

The protectors of Maraudon, the Maraudine, live in this centaur village. Only the bravest and mightiest of the tribe’s warriors are chosen to guard the tomb of [[Zaetar]] at Maraudon.

Besides the countless [[centaur]]s, one can also find [[Melizza Brimbuzzle]] here, a caged [[goblin]] who wants nothing more than to be let out of the valley.
